data.name: Meteor Blasters
data.detailed_description:
Survive The Chaos

Meteor Blasters is a fast-paced arcade space shooter built around momentum-based movement, explosive destruction, and relentless survival under pressure.

Drift through dangerous asteroid storms, dodge collapsing debris fields, and fight to stay alive as the battlefield spirals into chaos around you.

Every movement matters.

Master inertia-based flight controls, navigate unpredictable asteroid fields, and survive increasingly intense waves of destruction in a classic arcade experience inspired by the golden age of space shooters.

Momentum-Based Arcade Combat

Your ship is constantly in motion.

Meteor Blasters uses classic inertia-driven controls that force players to carefully manage speed, momentum, and positioning while surviving increasingly dangerous combat scenarios.

The faster the action becomes, the harder it is to stay in control.

React too slowly and you’ll crash into spinning debris, collide with asteroids, or drift directly into enemy fire.

Precision movement and quick reactions are the key to survival.

Endless Asteroid Destruction

Blast apart massive asteroid fields as dangerous debris floods the battlefield.

Every destroyed asteroid creates new hazards, transforming combat zones into chaotic storms of:

  • flying debris

  • explosive chain reactions

  • deadly collisions

  • unpredictable movement

The battlefield is constantly changing, forcing players to adapt and survive under mounting pressure.

Procedural Arcade Survival

No two battles play out the same way.

Procedurally generated asteroid fields create unpredictable combat situations filled with:

  • shifting hazards

  • escalating enemy pressure

  • dangerous environmental obstacles

  • constantly evolving survival scenarios

As the action intensifies, surviving even a few more seconds becomes a challenge.

Local Multiplayer Chaos

Play solo or battle with up to 4 players in local multiplayer modes.

Fight together to survive overwhelming asteroid storms in co-op mode, or compete against friends in frantic versus battles where momentum, positioning, and survival skills determine the winner.

With multiple ships drifting through collapsing asteroid fields simultaneously, every match becomes fast, unpredictable, and chaotic.

Features

  • Fast-paced arcade space shooter gameplay

  • Classic inertia-based movement system

  • Explosive asteroid destruction

  • Dangerous debris and chain reaction hazards

  • Procedurally generated asteroid fields

  • Increasingly intense survival gameplay

  • Local co-op multiplayer

  • Local versus multiplayer for up to 4 players

  • Classic retro-inspired arcade action

  • High-score focused gameplay

  • Challenging survival mechanics

  • Intense momentum-based ship control

Master The Drift

Meteor Blasters combines classic arcade inspiration with modern survival intensity.

Navigate impossible asteroid fields, maintain control under overwhelming pressure, and survive as long as possible while the battlefield collapses around you.

The longer you survive, the more dangerous the chaos becomes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 10 Series or Equivelent
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: On Board Sound
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Quad Core CPU 2.5 Ghz or Greater
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 30 Series or Greater
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: On Board Sound
